record_type: Scientific expectations, not measured H3 outcomes or performance gates
scope: Written after H3 launch and the first progress-only poll; no H3 effect tables or first full factorial block have been inspected by the parent

predictions.hypothesis: The retention/Consumer interaction requires an actual Canonical installation with already visible ahead progress whose complete private causal chain remains compatible with the newly selected root.
predictions.falsifiable_check: Count those actual witnessed installations separately from all Canonical installations, and compare joint vs single-factor effects. Large gains with no such opportunities require a different explanation.
predictions.negative_interpretation: Low-opportunity convergence is a normal operating boundary; failure to improve despite repeated witnessed compatible opportunities would weaken the proposed composition claim.

predictions.hypothesis: At lower load or before the next fine interval arrives, a faster trusted path can leave little ahead progress to preserve, so single-factor and joint implementations may converge.
predictions.falsifiable_check: Relate per-source effects to actual relative progress/installation clocks, not session count alone; preserve all source/cohort results.
predictions.negative_interpretation: A zero-rollback count alone does not establish a benefit if no rollback opportunity existed or if progress was delayed.

predictions.hypothesis: Changing Authority granularity can improve a backend's transcription behavior while decreasing exact cross-boundary private-chain compatibility, because segmentation and feedback histories change.
predictions.falsifiable_check: Keep rho1 and rho3 separate; jointly report task quality, witnessed compatibility, needed withdrawals, deadlines and retained progress. Do not pool incompatible update contracts.
predictions.negative_interpretation: The combination is not a promise that every native model/segmentation admits the same amount of reusable work.

predictions.hypothesis: Whisper fine-window repetition is an adapter/feedback-contract boundary rather than merely a display-policy fault or FP16-only error.
predictions.existing_basis: Six paid same-input FP32 repeats match old anomalies exactly; three whole-source empty-history quality references give 0, 4/53 and 0 word errors. These are different segmentation controls, not serving results.
predictions.falsifiable_check: Inspect repeated final development and all frozen H3 strata without replacing sources, changing budgets or adding fallback. Treat rho1/rho3 quality outcomes as measured results, not assumed repairs.

decision_policy: No prediction changes the frozen 110 cells, source selection, load, deadline, model budget or run order. Full Standard same-effect remains a valid positive alternative. Final paper judgment waits for complete actual evidence.
